lines.zh: 我背着壳在沙上走，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: I carry my shell across the sand, rocking with each step.

lines.zh: 八条腿踩下去，沙就陷一点。
lines.en: Eight legs go down and the sand gives a little.
Eight legs drag the shell along.

lines.zh: 壳太重了，我只能这样走。
lines.en: The shell is heavy. This is as fast as I go.
I can walk sideways or crooked. It makes no difference.

lines.zh: 一波浪退下去，我往前走几步。
lines.en: A wave withdraws and I take a few steps forward.

lines.zh: 潮湿的沙比干的沙好走。
lines.en: Wet sand is easier than dry.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头背上爬过去。
lines.en: I climb over the back of a stone.

lines.zh: 我的壳在沙上拖出一条痕。
lines.en: My shell drags a line in the sand.
I crunch a few empty shells underfoot.
I edge sideways into a gap in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我朝着有一点水的地方去。
lines.en: I head for the place where the water is.
My claw probes into the sand first.
I walk a stretch, then stop to listen.
Sand grains wedge between my legs.
On wet sand my feet hold well.
I draw all my legs into the shell.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，露出一片石滩。
lines.en: The tide is out and a stone flat appears.

lines.zh: 壳口朝外，我能看见一切。
lines.en: The shell opening faces out. I can see everything.
A seabird landed a short way off.
I wait for it to leave.
Seawater has wet my shell down.
Slowly I put out two legs.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，我不动。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand. I do not.
This shell fits me well.

lines.zh: 风里有咸味和腐烂的味。
lines.en: The wind carries salt and rot.
I am waiting for a bigger shell.
Footsteps approach from far off.
I listen and do not come out.
The sun has made the sand hot.
You are blocking my tide line.
Do not kick my shell.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才看得见你。
lines.en: You had to crouch before I could see you.
My legs are still inside.
Have you come looking for shells?

lines.zh: 这个壳是我换的第三个。
lines.en: This shell is my third.
Reach out and I withdraw.

lines.zh: 我在这里已经一整天了。
lines.en: I have been here all day.
I have turned over everything on this sand.
If you sit, sit further off.
The shell I drag is older than I am.
My shell opening turns toward your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的腿压麻了。
lines.en: That numbed one of my legs.
A piece is missing from my claw.
It was a long while before I put my head out.

lines.zh: 沙粘在我流出来的东西上。
lines.en: Sand sticks to what leaked out of me.
I backed off sideways some way.
The shell still guards me, for now.
I pull into my shell and count to three.

lines.zh: 我没有力气，可我还活着。
lines.en: I have no strength, but I am alive.
That is not worth coming out for.
I smell dead fish.
I put a claw out and test it.

lines.zh: 我把那团东西拖进壳口。
lines.en: I drag it to the shell opening.
That smells wrong. I push it away.
Do not shake your hand. I will misjudge the grip.
A little will last me a day.
I gather up every scrap.
There is a fair pile inside this shell.
What you set down, I take.

lines.zh: 我背着壳沿着潮线挪，一步一晃。
lines.en: I move along the tideline, shell swaying each step.
I pulled in and the shell tipped.
Your kick tips my shell halfway over.
The shell is hard. Does that not hurt?
I move off toward the stones.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我把腿收得更紧。
lines.en: At that bump I pull my legs in tighter.
Your boot is in my way.

lines.zh: 沙被我们踢得到处都是。
lines.en: We have kicked sand everywhere.
I sidestep half a block.
Touch me again and I stay in.

lines.zh: 沙上有许多像我这样的。
lines.en: There are many like me on this sand.
Their shells are all different colors.
One of them is always over by the rocks.

lines.zh: 我们碰一下触角，就各走。
lines.en: We touch antennae and go our ways.

lines.zh: 我们交换了壳上的气味。
lines.en: We trade the smells on each other's shells.
It watched while I changed shells.
It took a brighter one.
We never fight over them.
The tide came in and we scattered.

lines.zh: 第二天又在同一片沙上见。
lines.en: The next day we met on the same sand.

lines.zh: 我找到一个更合身的壳。
lines.en: I found a shell that fits better.

lines.zh: 这枚小小的一钳就夹住了。
lines.en: One claw holds this little one.
I leave the old shell where it lay.
Half a fish is buried in the sand.
This shell is cracked. No good to live in.

lines.zh: 我用钳子翻了一块石头。
lines.en: I turn a stone with one claw.
This one is too light. The wind would take it.
I heap the broken bits aside.
A cord has caught one of my legs.
I drag it into the shell to try it.
Something moves on the beach.
I put my eyes out of the shell.
It is two blocks from me.
Slowly I extend a claw.
I push my eyes out of the shell opening.

lines.zh: 沙挡住了我的半个身子。
lines.en: The sand hides half of me.
I edge sideways that way.
That distance is within reach.
I lift the shell opening.

lines.zh: 我拖着壳走，沙上留了一道沟。
lines.en: Dragging my shell, I leave a groove in the sand.
I move in along the sand.
This shell's too small — I want another.

lines.zh: 潮水在替我把声音盖住。
lines.en: The surf covers my noise.
I go around those few stones.
It has waded into the shallows.
I follow along the tideline.
Its feet have sunk in the sand.
From here the wind blows toward me.
I open my claw.
The tide pulls back; I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 我一钳夹住了它的脚趾。
lines.en: My claw closes on its toe.
It lifted its foot and I swung with it.
My other claw goes in.
Little strength, but the grip is tight.
It shook twice and could not free itself.
I drag it toward the rock gap.

lines.zh: 它踩了下来，我缩回壳里。
lines.en: It stomped and I withdrew into the shell.
The shell took the kick.

lines.zh: 我又伸出来，夹它的小腿。
lines.en: I come out again and take its calf.

lines.zh: 它喊了一声，海鸟飞走了。
lines.en: It shouted and the seabirds flew.

lines.zh: 我从潮水退去的地方出来。
lines.en: I come out where the tide withdrew.
I know this beach.

lines.zh: 我的壳是螺形的，尖端磨秃了。
lines.en: My shell is spiral and the tip worn blunt.
First I sniff this stretch of beach.

lines.zh: 沙上有新的脚印，不是我的。
lines.en: Fresh prints on the sand, and not mine.

lines.zh: 我把腿伸开，试了试地面。
lines.en: I spread my legs and test the ground.

lines.zh: 海风把我的触角吹得乱摆。
lines.en: The sea wind rakes my antennae.
There are a few empty shells beside me.
The sun has just cleared the water.
I crawl up to the tideline.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我不敢出来。
lines.en: The shell grew hot and I dare not come out.

lines.zh: 我从石头上翻下去，壳磕碎了。
lines.en: I tipped off a stone and the shell cracked.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到深处，我翻不过来。
lines.en: The tide carried me deep and I cannot right myself.
The blast flipped me, shell and all.
Something pierced the shell.
Strange light made the shell hot inside.
A whole day and nothing on the sand.
The bolt throws sparks off my shell.
The sand floor went and I fell into the dark.
